entries.name: Chikorita
entries.rationale: Small quadruped shape with def and spd 65 over atk 49 and spe 45 reads as a steady back-line body; GK tops roleBlends but a quadruped has no hands, so it stays outfield.

entries.name: Bayleef
entries.rationale: Def and spd 80 with spe 60 on a quadruped shape keeps it a defender; Layer 1 already handled the shape, so the baseline stands and GK is left out for lack of hands.

entries.name: Meganium
entries.rationale: Def and spd 100 on a heavy quadruped (weight 1005, height 18) make it a wall; Layer 1 still nudged DRI up for the shape, which a long-necked heavy body does not earn.

entries.name: Cyndaquil
entries.rationale: Spe 65 and spa 60 on a tiny humanoid frame (height 5, weight 79) with kickMoves like double-kick already give it quick feet; def 43 and hp 39 keep it off the back line.

entries.name: Quilava
entries.rationale: Spe 80 on a quadruped shape with double-kick and iron-head in kickMoves suits wide attacking runs; def 58 and weight 190 are light for defending.

entries.name: Typhlosion
entries.rationale: Spa 109 and spe 100 with mega-kick and low-kick in kickMoves already push SHO and KIC; the baseline captures an explosive forward and quadruped shape rules out GK.

entries.name: Totodile
entries.rationale: Genus Big Jaw and ability Sheer Force describe a biting, physical style, so TAK goes up slightly; spe 43 keeps it off the wing.

entries.name: Croconaw
entries.rationale: Genus Big Jaw with atk 80 and def 80 on an upright shape is a ball-winner; the jaw identity earns a small TAK bump that Layer 1 did not apply.

entries.name: Feraligatr
entries.rationale: Genus Big Jaw, atk 105 and def 100 at height 23 and weight 888 make it an imposing ball-winner; TAK gets the jaw bump while ACC 62 already reflects its bulk.

entries.name: Sentret
entries.rationale: Genus Scout and ability Keen Eye already lifted VIS through layer1Mods; spe 20, atk 46 and weight 60 leave little else, so it plays a watchful holding role in front of the back line.

entries.name: Furret
entries.rationale: Spe 90 and hp 85 suit a running wide role; genus Long Body means height 18 is body length rather than standing height, so AER 80 overstates its reach.

entries.name: Hoothoot
entries.rationale: Genus Owl with ability Keen Eye and wings shape already raised VIS and AER; atk 30 and spe 50 keep it a low-key defensive presence.

entries.name: Noctowl
entries.rationale: Hp 100, spd 96 and spa 86 with Keen Eye give VIS 86 and AER 89 from wings shape; atk 50 means it organizes rather than scores, and roleBlends favor GK.

entries.name: Ledyba
entries.rationale: Bug/flying type with wings shape and ability Swarm suits a supporting wide runner; atk 20 and def 30 at weight 108 rule out the middle of the pitch.

entries.name: Ledian
entries.rationale: Ledian's four-armed boxer design and hidden ability Iron Fist mean it has hands, which the wings shape penalty in Layer 1 ignored; spd 110 and spe 85 back REF 87 in goal.

entries.name: Spinarak
entries.rationale: Armor shape with spe 30 and atk 60 gives a slow, patient spider; ability Sniper does not translate to field play at spa 40, so the low baseline stands.

entries.name: Ariados
entries.rationale: Genus Long Leg on an armor shape can reach in and poke the ball away, so TAK rises slightly; hp 70 and atk 90 suit a trapping defender, and spe 40 limits pace.

entries.name: Crobat
entries.rationale: Spe 130 and four-winged bug-wings shape make it the fastest flyer here; its four-winged design has only tiny feet to strike a ball with, so SHO and KIC drop.

entries.name: Chinchou
entries.rationale: Fish shape already cut PAC, DRI and SHO hard in layer1Mods; hp 75 with spe 67 keeps a little stamina and reaction, so no further change.

entries.name: Lanturn
entries.rationale: Hp 125 gives STA 87 and spa 76 supports VIS; fish shape already removed pace and dribbling, so it holds the middle as a durable anchor.

entries.name: Pichu
entries.rationale: IsBaby, height 3 and weight 20 with def 15 make it fragile, while spe 60 keeps ACC 65; Layer 1 baby mods already cover the size gap.

entries.name: Cleffa
entries.rationale: IsBaby with spe 15 and height 3 is slow and tiny; ability Friend Guard and spd 55 make it a supportive midfielder, and baby mods already applied.

entries.name: Igglybuff
entries.rationale: Hp 90 lifts STA to 69 for an isBaby at weight 10; def 15 and spe 15 leave it physically outmatched, already reflected in layer1Mods, so it plays centrally where stamina matters.

entries.name: Togepi
entries.rationale: Def and spd 65 inside an egg design give some durability for an isBaby of height 3; atk 20 and spe 20 keep it out of scoring and defending duels.

entries.name: Togetic
entries.rationale: Fairy/flying type with wings in its design flies, but humanoid shape skipped the wing bonus, so AER 43 is too low; spa 80 and spd 105 support PAS 80 and VIS 79.

entries.name: Natu
entries.rationale: Height 2 and weight 20 make it the smallest bird here; its design has stubby, undersized wings, so the wings shape AER bonus is trimmed while spe 70 keeps ACC.

entries.name: Xatu
entries.rationale: Spa 95 and spe 95 with wings shape give VIS 79 and PAC 85; weight 150 at height 15 is light for duels, so it plays as a creative attacker.

entries.name: Mareep
entries.rationale: Spa 65 is its best stat and hidden ability Plus is a partner ability; spe 35 and atk 40 on a quadruped shape keep it a modest central support player.

entries.name: Flaaffy
entries.rationale: Spa 80 drives PAS and VIS 65 and upright shape with low-kick and mega-kick already lifted technique; spe 45 and def 55 limit it to a central link role.

entries.name: Ampharos
entries.rationale: Spa 115 and hp 90 give PAS and VIS 89 and STA 83, and genus Light fits a reference point; spe 55 at weight 615 keeps it off the flanks.

entries.name: Bellossom
entries.rationale: Spd 100 and spa 90 support PAS 83 and VIS 85, and triple-axel in kickMoves fits its dancer design; height 4 and weight 58 cannot back up PHY 57.

entries.name: Marill
entries.rationale: Ability Huge Power already added SHO 13 in layer1Mods; hp 70 lifts STA while height 4 and spe 40 keep it a small, steady full-back rather than a wide runner.

entries.name: Azumarill
entries.rationale: Hp 100 and def 80 give STA 87 and DEF 78, and Huge Power was already counted in SHO; spe 50 keeps it central rather than wide.

entries.name: Sudowoodo
entries.rationale: Def 115 and atk 100 with ability Sturdy, plus its franchise identity as the tree that blocks the route, make it a natural blocker; spe 30 rules out wide play.

entries.name: Politoed
entries.rationale: Spd 100 and spa 90 with hp 90 support PAS 87 and STA 84; its frog design and genus Frog mean strong jumping legs, so AER rises from 67.

entries.name: Hoppip
entries.rationale: Weight 5 and height 4 make it a cotton puff with stubby limbs; Layer 1 shape mods added DRI 8 that its tiny feet cannot fully back.

entries.name: Skiploom
entries.rationale: Spe 80 gives ACC 82, but weight 10 and the flower-puff design with stubby legs do not earn DRI 84 after a shape bonus of 8.

entries.name: Jumpluff
entries.rationale: Spe 110 earns real pace, but weight 30 and stubby cotton-ball limbs cannot carry DRI 98 or PHY 46 in contact.

entries.name: Aipom
entries.rationale: Genus Long Tail and its hand-tipped tail give a third hand the upright shape mods missed; spe 85 already drives ACC 83 and DRI 89.

entries.name: Sunkern
entries.rationale: Ball shape, height 3 and spe 30 describe a seed with tiny legs. Its light, small body already feeds ACC, so no change, and it stays deep where it need not run.

entries.name: Sunflora
entries.rationale: Spa 105 gives PAS 84 and VIS 86 while spe 30 caps PAC at 31; the humanoid shape with leaf arms already got its technique mods.

entries.name: Yanma
entries.rationale: Spe 95 plus ability Speed Boost and bug-wings shape already raised PAC and ACC; def 45 keeps it out of defensive roles.

entries.name: Wooper
entries.rationale: Hidden ability Unaware ignores stat changes, which reads as composure, while spe 15 and spa 25 limit pace and vision on its small legs shape.

entries.name: Quagsire
entries.rationale: Hp 95 with atk and def 85 at weight 750 give PHY 84 and STA 82; Unaware fits a calm defender and spe 35 keeps it central.

entries.name: Espeon
entries.rationale: Spa 130 and spe 110 give VIS 95 and PAS 93 and fit genus Sun as a creator; def 60 and quadruped shape keep it away from defending and goal.

entries.name: Umbreon
entries.rationale: Def 110 and spd 130 with hp 95 give DEF 94 and STA 88; GK tops roleBlends but a quadruped has no hands, so it anchors the back line instead.

entries.name: Murkrow
entries.rationale: Spe 91 and atk 85 at weight 21 suit a quick forward, and ability Prankster fits unpredictability; a crow on wings shape cannot hold DRI 89 with its talons.

entries.name: Slowking
entries.rationale: Spd 110 and spa 100 give VIS 92 and PAS 85, and abilities Own Tempo and Oblivious suit composure; spe 30 leaves PAC 35.

entries.name: Misdreavus
entries.rationale: Spe 85 and ability Levitate make it a floating, darting ghost. The ball shape has no legs at all, and Layer 1 now cuts DRI 20 for it, which leaves DRI 64 honest without a further trim.

entries.name: Unown
entries.rationale: Ball shape with no limbs and kickMoves empty mean it cannot strike the ball; ACC 51 still sits a little above its flat 48 spe line, so it is trimmed.

entries.name: Wobbuffet
entries.rationale: Genus Patient and its counter-only fighting style with ability Shadow Tag, which stops opponents escaping, describe a reactive marker; hp 190 backs STA 91.

entries.name: Girafarig
entries.rationale: Genus Long Neck at height 15 favours heading, and its second head on the tail watches behind it; spe 85 and double-kick in kickMoves suit attacking play.

entries.name: Pineco
entries.rationale: Def 90 and ability Sturdy on a ball shape with spe 15 give a stationary blocker; ball shape mods already removed dribbling and passing.

entries.name: Forretress
entries.rationale: Def 140 at weight 1258 with bug/steel type gives PHY 88; ball shape and spe 40 already cut its mobility, so the baseline holds.

entries.name: Dunsparce
entries.rationale: Hp 100 gives STA 86, but squiggle shape means height 15 is body length and its design has only tiny vestigial wings, so AER 74 is too generous.

entries.name: Gligar
entries.rationale: Def 105 and spe 85 with genus Fly Scorpion and ability Hyper Cutter fit a pincer-armed ball-winner; spa 35 keeps PAS and VIS low.

entries.name: Steelix
entries.rationale: Height 92 and weight 4000 make it by far the largest body here, and def 200 with Sturdy anchors defence; standing height that dwarfs every opponent lifts AER further.

entries.name: Snubbull
entries.rationale: Atk 80 and ability Intimidate fit a pugnacious bulldog, already lifted in TAK by layer1Mods; spe 30 and spa 40 keep it out of wide and creative roles.

entries.name: Granbull
entries.rationale: Atk 120 and Intimidate on an upright bulldog body at weight 487 suit a hard-tackling enforcer; spe 45 limits pace and Layer 1 already covered Quick Feet.

entries.name: Qwilfish
entries.rationale: Fish shape already cut its outfield ratings hard, including PAC; atk 95 and spe 85 with hidden ability Intimidate keep it a nuisance through the middle and up front.

entries.name: Scizor
entries.rationale: Atk 130 with ability Technician and pincer arms give TAK 92; weight 1180 of steel on small bug-wings shape does not earn the AER 95 that its wing bonus produced.

entries.name: Shuckle
entries.rationale: Def and spd 230 make it the hardest body to break down, but spe 5 (tied for the lowest of any species) and height 6 mean it barely moves, so PAC comes down. Its def and spd drive a high HAN baseline although it has no hands, so HAN comes down.

entries.name: Heracross
entries.rationale: Genus Single Horn and its horn-throwing style make it a heading threat, while atk 125 with Guts and Moxie drive shooting; spa 40 limits vision.

entries.name: Sneasel
entries.rationale: Spe 115 and genus Sharp Claw make it a quick nuisance, and hidden ability Pickpocket fits stealing the ball, so TAK rises; def 55 and hp 55 limit duels.

entries.name: Teddiursa
entries.rationale: Atk 80 on a small upright bear (height 6) with low-kick and mega-kick in kickMoves gives some shooting; spe 40 keeps PAC 43.

entries.name: Ursaring
entries.rationale: Atk 130 at weight 1258 with Guts gives PHY 90 and SHO 94; spe 55 and genus Hibernator suit a powerful but slow-starting presence.

entries.name: Slugma
entries.rationale: Squiggle shape with spe 20 and no limbs already cost it DRI and SHO; ability Flame Body punishes contact, so it holds a deep position.

entries.name: Magcargo
entries.rationale: Def 120 with Magma Armor and Flame Body on a squiggle shape makes a slow snail wall; spe 30 and missing limbs already show in DRI 15.

entries.name: Swinub
entries.rationale: Spe 50 on a small quadruped gives ACC 54, but its design with eyes hidden under hair limits what it sees, so VIS drops slightly.

entries.name: Piloswine
entries.rationale: Hp 100 and atk 100 at weight 558 with Thick Fat give PHY 86 and STA 84; its fur covers its eyes, so VIS 52 is trimmed.

entries.name: Corsola
entries.rationale: Def and spd 95 with Regenerator give DEF 85 on a small armor shape; spe 35 and height 6 keep it a compact holding player.

entries.name: Remoraid
entries.rationale: Genus Jet and ability Sniper fit a water-jet shooter from central areas, but fish shape already cut PAC and DRI; def 35 and hp 35 leave it fragile.

entries.name: Octillery
entries.rationale: Tentacles shape with Suction Cups already raised HAN, and atk and spa 105 with Sniper drive SHO 85; spe 45 keeps it central.

entries.name: Delibird
entries.rationale: Genus Delivery and its present-carrying design describe a player whose job is moving the ball on, so PAS rises; spe 75 on wings shape gives PAC 70.

entries.name: Mantine
entries.rationale: Height 21 and weight 2200 with a wide wings shape give AER 93 and reach; spd 140 lifts VIS, while spe 70 and no legs keep ACC 52.

entries.name: Skarmory
entries.rationale: Def 140 with steel/flying type and Sturdy at height 17 gives DEF 84 and AER 92; spa 40 limits its passing.

entries.name: Houndour
entries.rationale: Spe 65 and spa 80 on a quadruped dog give ACC 68; def 30 and weight 108 keep it light in duels.

entries.name: Houndoom
entries.rationale: Spa 110 and spe 95 with hidden ability Unnerve make it a menacing forward; def 50 keeps it out of defence.

entries.name: Kingdra
entries.rationale: Balanced 95s with height 18 and weight 1520 give DEF 85 and PHY 87; blob shape already cut DRI and TEC, and Sniper fits occasional long shots.

entries.name: Phanpy
entries.rationale: Hp 90 at weight 335 gives STA 75 and PHY 66 for a small quadruped; spe 40 and spa 40 limit pace and passing.

entries.name: Donphan
entries.rationale: Atk and def 120 at weight 1200 with genus Armor and Sturdy give TAK 94 and PHY 93; spe 50 and quadruped shape keep it deep.

entries.name: Porygon2
entries.rationale: Spa 105 and spd 95 with abilities Download and Analytic fit a computed, disciplined playmaker; spe 60 and height 6 limit pace and aerial play.

entries.name: Stantler
entries.rationale: Genus Big Horn with antlers at height 14 helps in the air, and spe 85 with jump-kick and double-kick in kickMoves already suit a forward.

entries.name: Smeargle
entries.rationale: Spe 75 drives PAC 69, and genus Painter with its copy-any-move identity fits unpredictability; atk 20 and def 35 keep it light.

entries.name: Tyrogue
entries.rationale: Genus Scuffle with high-jump-kick and low-kick in kickMoves already raised SHO and KIC; isBaby with flat 35 stats leaves it raw.

entries.name: Hitmontop
entries.rationale: Genus Handstand and a kickMoves list led by rolling-kick and triple-kick already drove the largest kick mods; spd 110 and def 95 add defensive bite.

entries.name: Smoochum
entries.rationale: Spa 85 and spe 65 give PAS 70 and ACC 62 for an isBaby; def 15 and height 4 rule out physical duels.

entries.name: Elekid
entries.rationale: Spe 95 with rolling-kick and low-kick in kickMoves gives ACC 83 and DRI 88; isBaby and def 37 keep it fragile.

entries.name: Magby
entries.rationale: Spe 83 and atk 75 give ACC 72 and DRI 79; isBaby and def 37 limit contact, already reflected in the baby mods.

entries.name: Miltank
entries.rationale: Spe 100, def 105 and hp 95 with Thick Fat give PAC 85, PHY 87 and STA 84, and its Rollout charging identity suits an overlapping full-back; spa 40 limits passing.

entries.name: Blissey
entries.rationale: Hp 255 and ability Healer make it a tireless support player, but atk and def 10 mean it loses physical contact, so PHY 60 drawn from hp is trimmed.

entries.name: Raikou
entries.rationale: Spe 115 and spa 115 give PAC 96 and VIS 91; GK tops roleBlends but a quadruped legendary has no hands, so it attacks instead.

entries.name: Entei
entries.rationale: Atk 115 and hp 115 at weight 1980 give SHO 91 and PHY 91; quadruped shape rules out goal, and VIS 76 from spa 90 and spd 75 is the soft spot in its profile.

entries.name: Suicune
entries.rationale: Def and spd 115 with hp 100 give DEF 95 and STA 90; quadruped shape rules out goal despite GK topping roleBlends.

entries.name: Larvitar
entries.rationale: Weight 720 at height 6 is very dense and Layer 1 already raised PHY; spe 41 and genus Rock Skin keep it a sturdy, slow defender.

entries.name: Pupitar
entries.rationale: Genus Hard Shell on a limbless squiggle shape at weight 1520 already lost DRI and TEC; atk 84 and def 70 keep it a blocker.

entries.name: Tyranitar
entries.rationale: Atk 134 at height 20 and weight 2020 with Unnerve give PHY 96 and SHO 99; spe 61 and its bulk already show in ACC 43.

entries.name: Lugia
entries.rationale: Height 52 and wings shape give AER 99 and huge reach, and spd 154 with Multiscale makes it hard to beat; atk 90 is its lowest stat, so SHO 78 and DRI 70 are its soft spots.

entries.name: Ho-Oh
entries.rationale: Atk 130 and spd 154 at height 38 with wings shape give AER 99 and TAK 93; Regenerator fits STA 95 and its size holds ACC at 68.

entries.name: Celebi
entries.rationale: Flat 100 stats give elite DRI and PAS. Weight 50 already holds PHY at 66 and TAK at 73, so those stand, but height 6 gives no reach to handle a shot, so HAN drops; it hovers on small wings, so AER 58 is lifted a little.
